name: EcomNestWeb Product Designer for WooCommerce
author: Ecom Nest Web

sections.description:
EcomNestWeb Product Designer for WooCommerce allows store owners to offer custom vector personalization on WooCommerce products with real-time live preview, custom font manager, SVG template manager, and configurable preview canvas background colors.

Developed by Md. Tanvir Ahmed (eCommerce Specialist / Lead Developer at Ecom Nest Web).

Features

  • Font Manager with TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2 upload & drag-and-drop reordering.
  • Font Preview Modal with interactive sample text (No file download!).
  • SVG Template Manager with strict sanitization (strips malicious scripts).
  • Custom Preview Canvas Background Color (global & per-product override).
  • WooCommerce Product Edit Metabox with [Select All] / [Deselect All] font & color controls.
  • Direct WhatsApp Order Button with pre-formatted custom specs.
  • Direct Buy Now Button for instant checkout.
  • Order Details Admin view with One Click Print Vector Design.
sections.installation:
1. Upload ecomnest-name-personalizer folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings under ‘Product Designer’ menu in WordPress Admin.

short_description: Lightweight WooCommerce product designer with font manager, SVG templates, live vector preview, custom canvas bg & direct checkout.
